Loading libraries
```{r}
library(Signac)
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratDisk)
library(SeuratObject)
library(SeuratData)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(future)
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)
library(Azimuth)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)

plan("multisession", workers = 115)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 100000 * 1024^2) # for 100 Gb RAM
```

process_rna function
```{r}
process_rna <- function(sample_id) {
  # Construct file paths
  rna_path <- paste0("/home/tjq4954/Multiome_PBMC/Data/multiome_", sample_id, "/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
  # Load RNA-seq data
  rna_sample <- Read10X_h5(filename = rna_path)
  
  rna_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = rna_sample, project = paste0("RNA_", sample_id)
                                   # , min.cells = 3, min.features = 200
                                   )

  # This assumes that your mitochondrial genes start with "MT-"
  rna_seurat[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(rna_seurat, pattern = "^MT-")
  
  # QC steps: Filter cells, Normalize, Find variable features, Scale data
  # rna_seurat <- subset(rna_seurat, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 5000 & percent.mt < 10)
  print(paste("Subset done for sample", sample_id))
  
  # Get the number of cells in each Seurat object
  rna_cell_count <- length(colnames(rna_seurat))
  print(paste("RNA cell count:", rna_cell_count))
  
  # Delete an interfering layer -- can later add ATAC info
  rna_seurat[["RNA"]]$counts.Peaks <- NULL

  rna_seurat <- SCTransform(rna_seurat, vars.to.regress = "percent.mt", verbose = FALSE)
  rna_seurat <- RunPCA(rna_seurat, verbose = FALSE)
  rna_seurat <- RunUMAP(rna_seurat, dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)
  
  return(rna_seurat)
}
```

Sample processing
```{r}
# Define Sample IDs
samples <- c("280", "302", "72", "203", "271", "294")

# Process each RNA-seq sample
rna_objects <- lapply(samples, process_rna)

# setwd("/home/tjq4954/Multiome_PBMC/Data/rna")
# rna_objects <- readRDS("rna_objects.rds")

plan("multisession", workers = 115)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 100000 * 1024^2) # for 100 Gb RAM

# Integration
  # Select integration features
  integration.features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = rna_objects, nfeatures = 3000)

  # Prep for SCT integration
  pbmc.rna <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = rna_objects, anchor.features = integration.features, verbose = FALSE)

  # Find integration anchors
  anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = pbmc.rna, normalization.method = "SCT", anchor.features = integration.features, verbose = FALSE)

  # Integrate data
  pbmc.rna <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors, normalization.method = "SCT", verbose = FALSE)

  # Run PCA
  pbmc.rna <- RunPCA(pbmc.rna, verbose = FALSE)

  # Find neighbors
  pbmc.rna <- FindNeighbors(pbmc.rna, dims = 1:30)

  # Find clusters
  pbmc.rna <- FindClusters(pbmc.rna, resolution = 0.6)
  
  # Azimuth annotation
  pbmc.rna <- RunAzimuth(pbmc.rna, reference = "pbmcref")
```

Saving the Seurat object
```{r}
# Specify the full path with the filename for the RDS file
save_path <- "/home/tjq4954/Multiome_PBMC/Data/rna/pbmc.rna.rds"

saveRDS(pbmc.rna, file = save_path)
```
